While the study discusses ubiquitination regulation in the results, no specific ubiquitin-remnant enrichment (e.g., diGly) was performed for the MS analysis; it was a global LFQ proteome study.

scope: We performed a quantitative proteomic analysis to fully characterize the Nef-induced changes in protein composition of T cell-derived EVs
For the mass spectrometry (MS) analysis, the final pellets of EVs from A3.01 cells (GFP and Nef/GFP) were frozen at −80 °C after ultracentrifugation for posterior digestion
The frozen EV pellet was suspended in 8 M urea, reduced with 5 mM DTT for 25 min at 56 °C and alkylated with 14 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature and light protected.
GFP-EVs and Nef/GFP-EVs derived peptides were loaded into the EASY-nLC II (Proxeon Biosystem) coupled to the mass spectrometer LTQ Orbitrap Velos (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
